audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's 'diff' enum reads EVEN while diffRating, breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t all say 8/10 / 'Hard matchup'. The page renders two different difficulty verdicts.
audit.why: Three of the four difficulty fields say hard; only the enum disagrees, so aligning the enum is the minimal consistent fix. Enum fields are length-exempt. The level chart itself needs no change: packet.levelChart is Vayne on all seven rows and full phases[].side and content win[] already agree row for row.

Spike windows check out: Condemn is 20/18/16/14/12s, Final Hour is 100/85/70s, and Vayne's real power is the W percent-max-HP true damage ramping with attack speed items. spikes[] has 4 entries with correct 'when' values.
audit.corrected: Timings kept; spike prose corrected for the Purgatory interaction (point 4).

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction is absent and the page states its opposite. whys[4], spikes[1], 'mid', 'late' and wants.foe[2] all claim Final Hour's Tumble stealth lets her dodge or beat Purgatory. Locke's R carries a grounding flag — grounding shuts off dashes, and Tumble is a dash. Inside the zone she cannot Tumble at all, which removes the stealth reposition and the kiting her level 6 is built on.
audit.why: This is the single mechanic that gives Locke a lane answer against Vayne, and the page currently tells the player the reverse. Stealth on Tumble is real (Riot's R text), but it only exists if she can cast Tumble.
audit.corrected: Purgatory grounds Tumble. Drop the zone under her feet, not where she is running to, and Final Hour becomes an AD steroid with no repositioning attached.
sources: ownerKit R flags: grounding 'shuts off enemy dashes'

audit.why: Condemn at 20s rank 1 down to 12s at rank 5 is her only defensive answer to Locke's E, and the page already names it as the tracked cooldown in breakdown.cooldowns and focus.text.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer refers to Vayne as 'he/his' throughout (tradeGood, enemyWin, dontsFull, breakdown.wave). Templated text, not a mechanical error.
audit.why: Cosmetic but visible on a paid page. Not proposed as edits here because they are boilerplate strings shared across many matchups and a per-matchup pronoun edit risks fighting the template regeneration.
audit.corrected: Flagged in notes for a template-level fix rather than per-matchup edits.

edits.before: Final Hour stealth dodges your Purgatory commit at 6.
edits.after: Purgatory grounds Tumble — she cannot dash out of it.

edits.before: Final Hour (R) gives her stealth on Tumble and a huge AD steroid, so even your Purgatory setup gets kited; she invisibly repositions the instant you commit and her W true damage races your execute threshold.
edits.after: Final Hour (R) gives her stealth on Tumble and a huge AD steroid, so she repositions mid-combo — but Purgatory grounds Tumble, and a Vayne stuck inside the zone loses the kiting her entire level 6 depends on.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 she only pulls further ahead as her W true damage scales. Level 6 Final Hour is the killer: the Tumble stealth lets her dodge your Purgatory commit and reposition mid-combo, while the AD steroid lets her shred you before your burst lands. Hold E defensively for her all-ins, stay away from walls, and look to roam or trade with jungle help rather than solo her.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 she only pulls further ahead as her W true damage scales, and Final Hour's AD steroid plus Tumble stealth lets her reposition mid-combo before your burst lands. Your one real answer is Purgatory's grounding: dropped under her feet it locks Tumble off entirely. Hold E defensively, stay away from walls, and trade with jungle help rather than soloing her.

edits.before: Late Vayne is a hard loss for you. Percent-max-HP true damage ignores everything you build, her R stealth beats your totem timing, and Condemn punishes the E blink that is your only gap-close. Buy armor and HP to survive a single rotation, but accept you cannot duel her; play with a frontline that can wall her off and force Condemn before you ever commit.
edits.after: Late Vayne is a hard loss for you. Percent-max-HP true damage ignores everything you build, and Condemn punishes the E blink that is your only gap-close. Buy armor and HP to survive a rotation, but accept you cannot duel her; play with a frontline that forces Condemn first, and land Purgatory on her feet — grounded, she cannot Tumble clear of it.

notes: QUESTION-ADJACENT: winRate is 49.31% over 1156 games, which reads EVEN, yet diffRating/breakdown/report all say 8/10 hard. I aligned the enum to the majority (HARD) rather than rewriting three prose fields; if the 49.31% figure should govern, the ratings need lowering instead.
